31. (1) The Commission may, subject to the provisions of
this Act, make rules in respect of any matter for which rules
are authorised to be made under this Act or all or any of the
following matters: -

(a)
for the regulation of the procedure to be followed
for the summoning and holding of meetings of the
Commission and the transaction of business at such
meetings;  and

(b)
any other matter connected with the management
of the affairs of the Commission.
(2)  Every  rule  made  by  the  Commission  shall  be
published in the Gazette and shall come into operation on
the date of its publication or on such later date as may be
specified therein.
